ops.title: PR269: activate the generation the duplicate check read
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyf@poetic.com>. Next: retain the observed generation and authority identity with each activation request; promote only when that observed state remains eligible, without regressing past a newer activation or using a later current. Evidence: internal/store/query_activation.go:25 and :38; /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/ccn-write-floor-review/pr269-_qireoxt/activation-results.txt:4 through :6. A read at generation 3 followed by another Store publication at 4 activates 4, and the generation-3 pin misses.

ops.text: An interleaved writer never causes activation of an unread generation; pinned lookup remains correct; duplicate-without-publication and transaction rollback have explicit regression coverage.
